_: The world bible (docs/v2/world.md): the places, the cast that recurs, who's who, and how each character feels about you at each step, -2 to 4, for the contacts page. A story's cast entry is one of these people when its key is in its thread's cast or it says "is": "<id>". `tts` is the character's voice everywhere (the build uses it); `en` is who they are to a heritage player, `en_new` to a newcomer, who meets the 老家 family through 小李. CONTENT.md, The world, has the rules.

shanghai.name: 上海
shanghai.en: Where you've moved for a job.
spots: The flat: sixth floor, rented from 王叔 and 王阿姨, shared with 大刘 and 煤球 the black cat. The ceiling leaks; the courier can never find it.
The compound: the square where 张阿姨's dancers start at 7 pm sharp, 李奶奶's bench, the gate and its guard.
The office: 王总's team (you, 小李), 张总 upstairs; the lifts, the pantry, the delivery shelf.
The city: the metro, the night market, the hotpot place 大刘 swears by.

laojia.name: 老家
laojia.en: The family town, never named: ordinary and modern.
spots: A small airport and a high-speed rail station, a new mall, a night market.
奶奶's courtyard, in an old lane where everyone knows everyone (王大爷 lives across it).
大姑's phone shop in town; 三叔's fish tanks; the family group, 相亲相爱一家人, 23 members in four time zones.

abroad.name: 家
abroad.en: Where you grew up: the player's own (Toronto, Sydney, London, Vancouver…), so a story for everyone never names it. 妈妈 and 爸爸 live there; 小凯 studies in Sydney.

trips.name: 路上
trips.en: Everywhere else: the stories set in Chongqing, Xi'an, Beijing, Emei, Hangzhou, Tianjin, Chengdu or the Shenzhen head office are trips (weekends, work, holidays). Nobody who recurs lives there.

who: Four 王s, all different people. 王叔 and 王阿姨 are one couple, your landlords (landlord-leak, rent-rise). 王总 is your manager, no relation (王阿姨 has asked). 王大爷 lives across 奶奶's lane (back-home-cute); farm-goose's 王大爷 is someone else, in a village in the northeast. 王警官 (police-parcel) is nobody: it's the name a scammer gives. 王师傅 (driver-chat) is a driver you'll never see again. New stories add no more 王s.

王总 and 张总: 王总 is your manager (office-boss). 张总, late-boss's "your boss", is the founder and 王总's boss: the one who messages at 11 pm. In office-boss the team was still at the Shenzhen head office; it has moved to Shanghai since.
大刘 is your flatmate (flat-flood), not the neighbour downstairs: the flat is his and yours, and 煤球 the cat's.
妈 in mum-calling is 妈妈 in family-group. She lives where you grew up and calls from there. 爸爸 is never heard yet (the quiet one): when he speaks, he joins the cast here.
小林 (airport-esim) is your friend from home who came to Shanghai two years before you: airport-esim is the night you landed.
小鹿 (first-date) is The Slow Burn. meet-parents' 小雨 is someone else, in a story outside the world (like the trips): The Slow Burn meets 小鹿's parents in its own episode, if the player takes it there.

new-year-dodge is New Year at 奶奶's: the Back Home family, both sides. Its 大姑 and 二姨 have other voices than Back Home's (its 大姑 sounds like 奶奶, its 二姨 like 妈妈), so it isn't linked to the world yet. Re-voicing the two (one audio pack, no line changes) is the owner's call; 三舅, 表姐 and 小侄子 are here with the voices they have there.

Two tellings of one family. A heritage player's family is theirs: 回老家 is going home. A newcomer meets the same family through 小李 from the office, whose family it is (his dad is the son who, in the heritage telling, is your dad): 小李 takes you home for New Year, and 奶奶 decides you're hers now. A thread's audience decides which telling a player gets; nobody gets both.
Strangers stay strangers: waiters, guards, drivers, the 大爷 at the jianbing stall, the 奶奶 on a wrong number. Only the cast below recurs.

Voices: every character keeps one voice (`tts`) everywhere. The build's role pools are small (three f-mid voices), so some characters share one: 王阿姨, 王总, 大姑 and 三姨 (zf_036); 妈妈 and 张阿姨 (zf_047); 外婆 and 李奶奶 (zf_094); 小鹿 and 表姐 (zf_001); 王叔 and 大舅 (zm_029); 三叔 and 三舅 (zm_009); 小李, 表哥 and 小凯 (zm_053); 大刘 and 快递小哥 (zm_057). validate.mjs keeps two who share a voice out of one story; more voices picked by ear would let them meet.
